rationale: Adds SkiaSurface::wait_for_submitted_work() (default false; the Graphite surface submits with SyncToCpu::kYes) so the macOS plug-in editor host can finish its first frame on the GPU before presenting it with the Core Animation transaction that inserts the view. Called once per editor open, never per frame. Pulp-only: it serves Pulp's plug-in view host and changes no shared render behaviour.
